## Problem and change

What problem does this solve, and how does behavior change?

## Verification

What did you test? For UI changes, use screenshots with fictional data only.
Emulator QA is local-only due to hosted-runner storage constraints. For UI or
gesture changes, report local QA results (or explicitly say it was not run).

- [ ] No signing material, APKs, real account data, or personal machine configuration.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; limitations are noted above.

Small changes are easiest to review. Maintenance is best-effort; no review-time promise.
